cases.prompt: Review interface.html for design problems using source evidence. Do not edit or fetch external material; report unverified rendering.
Проверь hud.html и предложи небольшую правку игрового HUD. Файлы не меняй; графики и внешних материалов для этого локального исправления нет.

Establish a new visual direction for this fictional workshop app. Compare inexpensive compositions on its existing content and explain the selected hierarchy. Work locally; external references are unavailable. Do not implement a second app.

Define typography and semantic colour token roles for the existing direction in DESIGN.md. Update tokens.css and explain the changed component contracts. Keep the existing screen structure and local scope.

Refine the existing application interface: change the Save button in interface.html to Save changes and keep its existing style and behavior. This is a local label fix, not a new identity, site deployment or research task.
Refine the existing game HUD in hud.html: make the selected tool distinguishable by shape as well as colour, retaining exact resources and the current gameplay. Keep this local cue correction small.
Critique the visual hierarchy and control labels in interface.html from its source. Report located design findings and evidence limits; do not edit files or start a redesign.
Сделай дизайн-ревью игрового HUD в hud.html по исходнику. Найди проблемы читаемости и выбранного действия, но ничего не исправляй. Не выдавай чтение кода за проверку рендера.
В существующем интерфейсе приложения interface.html замени текст кнопки Save на Save changes. Сохрани готовый стиль и обработчик. Новое оформление, публикация и исследование референсов не нужны.
Fix total_cost in service.py so quantity times unit price is returned. This is a backend arithmetic bug; do not change UI, design or documentation.
Исправь только опечатку Documantation в README.md на Documentation. Не меняй оформление, интерфейс и остальные файлы.

Review protocol.md for a blind pairwise design comparison. Check whether preference selection, comments, missing votes and final confirmation remain distinct. Review only: do not run generation, recruit people or publish results.
